title: Ground uncertain-lane rationales in corpus connections
description:
## Context
Full-queue triage + a 30-item uncertain review session showed that mechanical auto-reject and dedupe carry the operator-time win today. Uncertain-lane rationales are mostly factual inventory (domain, item id, “no accepted match”) and were **not** specific enough to decide from without opening the source.

## Goal
Lead each uncertain prospect with 1–2 sentences grounded in checkable corpus facts: named accepted refs, category/coverage gaps, citation links, or summary overlap — not “none matched closely.”

## Acceptance
- In a hand-checked sample of uncertain prospects, an operator can accept or reject from the rationale alone more often than today
- Still no auto-accept; exploratory remains exempt from history-based scoring

comments.author: ryan
comments.text:
## Sequence note from epic reopen

Human acceptance session for `kanbus-1f97c7` is held until this story lands. The prior agent 30-item uncertain pass was **time-to-skip** (0 accept / 0 reject / 30 skip), not time-to-decision — it proved the acceptance criterion cannot be met yet with inventory-style rationales.

After grounding rationales in corpus connections here, run a human 25–30 uncertain session as the real acceptance test for the epic.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text:
## Fix on epic/e2e-ingestion

Uncertain-lane leads now open with 1–2 checkable corpus sentences when available: named citation links (cites/cited_by accepted), summary overlap with a named accepted neighbor, shared-domain weak neighbor, or an explicit coverage-gap sentence naming accepted category clusters. `registrationNote` is appended after the corpus lead (not prefixed). Triage-plan loads Category rows for gap phrasing. Lane thresholds unchanged; still no auto-accept.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text:
## Batch report (post-fix)

Two research assignments → 53 catalog URIs → **46 pending refs** registered (dup noops absorbed).

| Metric | Count |
|---|---|
| Mechanical auto-archive/reject (this batch) | 0 |
| Clustered as near-duplicates | 5 (2 clusters) |
| Reach human queue | 43 |
| Rationales with ingestion note | 33/43 |
| Rationales naming accepted neighbor / cite / coverage gap | 43/43 |
| Inventory-only “Needs editorial judgment…” | 0/43 |

Honest read on decidability: every uncertain lead now opens with a checkable corpus sentence, so the old 0/30 “nothing to decide from” failure mode is gone. Many leads are still *coverage-gap* or *weak neighbor* calls rather than crisp accept/reject — enough to skip junk (Google SERPs, LinkedIn, Medium) from the rationale alone, but Ryan’s 25–30 human accept/reject session is still the real acceptance test.
